name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWE.tdre_cancel
title: TDRE cancellation identity: the difference of two LWE samples on one matrix
statement: For any matrix A over a commutative ring, (s1 A + e1) - (s2 A + e2) = (s1 - s2) A + (e1 - e2). This is the identity behind threshold difference revealing encryption (Aggarwal-Jain-Lin-Wu, ePrint 2026/2927, Construction 6.1): the difference of two encodings under one public matrix is an LWE sample in the secret difference whose error is the difference of the encoded messages.
